payload.text: **File a devbin issue: every run: word is glob-expanded against the project root, and a run: of nothing but space runs the option's own arguments as the command, rc 0.** Measured through the dispatcher at f34753f; the transcript is at scratchpad/run-glob-transcript.md (copy it into the issue verbatim). Found by critic-shell reviewing WP-02's notes.run, which expands the same way. One ruling for every run: site (split without globbing, or document that globs expand) and a refusal of a run: with no words. WP-02 already refuses a blank notes.run on its own.
